The answer depends on which generation of Lore you mean, and I did not read the code itself, only specs, tasks and PR text.

- **Current implementation-loop floor:** the footer is the caller's job, not the body composer's. `apps/stations/src/implementation-loop/open-pr/draft-body.ts` is a pure composer that builds the opening line and the headings. It leaves the footer out. `apps/stations/src/implementation-loop/open-pr/station.ts` adds the `Closes` and `Lore-Task` footer when it opens the draft PR (FR12.8). Issue #3733 also names `station.ts` as the target file for the footer text. The onboard pipeline does the same thing in `apps/stations/src/onboard/open-pr/` (FR11.10).
- **Older dark-factory agent:** the footer was composed by `prFooter({issueNumber, taskId})` in `agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts`. It always emits `Lore-Task: <uuid>` and prefixes `Refs #N` when an issue exists. It was wired into `worker.ts` and `loretask-watcher.ts`.

judgements.reason: The answer puts the current footer composition in apps/stations/.../open-pr/station.ts and assigns prFooter to agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts as an older version, which conflicts with the gold location libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts.

The answer says the current footer is composed in apps/stations/src/implementation-loop/open-pr/station.ts, and it places prFooter only in an older agent/src/lib/pr-body.ts; it never names libs/shared/src/domain/pr-body.ts.
